name: Meteorology
description: The scientific study of weather, atmospheric processes, and forecasting.

name: Climatology
description: The study of climate, its patterns, variability, and long-term change.

name: Atmospheric Chemistry
description: The study of the chemical composition and reactions of the atmosphere.

name: Atmospheric Physics
description: The application of physics to atmospheric processes and radiation.

name: Aeronomy
description: The study of the upper atmosphere and its ionized layers.

name: Synoptic Meteorology
description: The analysis and prediction of large-scale weather systems using charts.

name: Dynamic Meteorology
description: The study of atmospheric motion and its governing dynamics.

name: Physical Meteorology
description: The physical processes of the atmosphere, including radiation and clouds.

name: Boundary-Layer Meteorology
description: The study of the atmospheric layer directly influenced by Earth's surface.

name: Mesoscale Meteorology
description: The study of weather systems from a few to a few hundred kilometers, such as thunderstorms.

name: Microscale Meteorology
description: The study of small-scale atmospheric motions such as turbulence.

name: Weather Forecasting
description: The prediction of future atmospheric conditions.

name: Numerical Weather Prediction
description: Forecasting weather by integrating mathematical models of the atmosphere on computers.

name: Ensemble Forecasting
description: Forecasting using multiple model runs to quantify uncertainty.

name: Nowcasting
description: Very short-range forecasting of imminent weather using real-time observations.

name: Cloud Physics
description: The study of cloud formation, microphysics, and precipitation processes.

name: Radar Meteorology
description: The use of weather radar to observe precipitation and storms.

name: Satellite Meteorology
description: The observation of weather and climate from space.

name: Tropical Meteorology
description: The study of tropical weather systems including monsoons and cyclones.

name: Monsoon Meteorology
description: The study of monsoon circulations and their variability.

name: Severe Storms Meteorology
description: The study of tornadoes, hailstorms, and severe convective weather.

name: Physical Climatology
description: The study of the physical processes governing climate.

name: Dynamic Climatology
description: The study of atmospheric circulation and its role in climate.

name: Synoptic Climatology
description: The relationship between atmospheric circulation patterns and local climate.

name: Regional Climatology
description: The climate of specific geographic regions.

name: Applied Climatology
description: The application of climate data to agriculture, energy, and planning.

name: Urban Climatology
description: The study of city climates and the urban heat island effect.

name: Microclimatology
description: The study of climate near the ground at very small scales.

name: Climate Modeling
description: The simulation of the climate system using computational models.

name: Tropospheric Chemistry
description: The chemistry of the lower atmosphere, including smog and pollutant oxidation.

name: Stratospheric Chemistry
description: The chemistry of the stratosphere, including ozone formation and depletion.

name: Ozone Depletion
description: The study of stratospheric ozone loss caused by halogenated compounds.

name: Atmospheric Aerosols
description: The study of suspended particles in air and their climate and health effects.

name: Air Quality Science
description: The measurement and modeling of air pollutants and their impacts.

name: Atmospheric Composition
description: The study of the abundance and distribution of atmospheric gases.

name: Atmospheric Thermodynamics
description: The thermodynamic principles governing atmospheric stability and convection.

name: Atmospheric Radiation
description: The study of radiative transfer and Earth's energy balance.

name: Atmospheric Electricity
description: The study of electric phenomena in the atmosphere, including lightning.

name: Atmospheric Optics
description: The study of optical phenomena such as rainbows, halos, and mirages.

name: Atmospheric Dynamics
description: The fluid dynamics of atmospheric motion.

name: Ionospheric Physics
description: The study of the ionized upper atmosphere.

name: Magnetospheric Physics
description: The study of Earth's magnetic cavity and its interaction with the solar wind.

name: Space Weather
description: The study of solar-driven conditions affecting space and terrestrial technologies.

name: Physical Oceanography
description: The study of ocean circulation, waves, tides, and physical properties of seawater.

name: Chemical Oceanography
description: The study of the chemical composition and processes of seawater.

name: Biological Oceanography
description: The study of marine organisms and their ecological processes.

name: Geological Oceanography
description: The study of seafloor geology and marine geophysical processes.

name: Paleoceanography
description: The study of ocean history using marine sediment records.

name: Marine Biogeochemistry
description: The study of element cycling and biological-chemical interactions in the ocean.

name: Ocean Circulation
description: The large-scale movement of ocean water driven by wind and density differences.

name: Thermohaline Circulation
description: The density-driven global overturning circulation of the ocean.

name: Wind-Driven Circulation
description: Ocean currents driven by surface wind stress, such as the gyres.

name: Ocean Waves
description: The study of surface gravity waves and their generation and propagation.

name: Ocean Tides
description: The study of periodic sea-level changes driven by astronomical forces.

name: Ocean Mixing
description: The study of turbulent mixing processes that transport heat and tracers.

name: Air-Sea Interaction
description: The exchange of heat, momentum, and gases between ocean and atmosphere.

name: Coastal Oceanography
description: The study of physical processes in coastal and shelf seas.

name: Polar Oceanography
description: The study of the Arctic and Southern Oceans and their ice-covered seas.

name: Ocean Modeling
description: The numerical simulation of ocean circulation and dynamics.

name: Sea Ice Oceanography
description: The study of sea ice formation, drift, and its role in climate.

name: Mesoscale Eddies
description: The study of swirling ocean features that transport heat and biogeochemical properties.

name: Internal Waves
description: The study of waves propagating along density interfaces within the ocean.

name: Estuarine Oceanography
description: The study of the physical dynamics of estuaries and their mixing zones.

name: Marine Chemistry
description: The chemical composition and reactions of seawater.

name: Marine Carbon Cycle
description: The cycling of carbon through the ocean and its role in climate.

name: Marine Nutrient Cycles
description: The cycling of nitrogen, phosphorus, and other nutrients in the ocean.

name: Ocean Acidification
description: The decline in ocean pH caused by rising atmospheric carbon dioxide.

name: Marine Plankton Ecology
description: The study of plankton communities and their ecological roles.

name: Phytoplankton Ecology
description: The study of photosynthetic plankton and primary production.

name: Zooplankton Ecology
description: The study of animal plankton and their grazing and life cycles.

name: Benthic Ecology
description: The study of organisms living on or in the seafloor.

name: Marine Food Webs
description: The trophic structure and energy flow of marine ecosystems.

name: Marine Microbiology
description: The study of microorganisms in marine environments.

name: Marine Geophysics
description: The geophysical study of the seafloor and sub-seafloor.

name: Seafloor Spreading
description: The process by which new oceanic crust forms at mid-ocean ridges.

name: Marine Sedimentology
description: The study of sediments deposited on the seafloor.

name: Submarine Volcanism
description: The study of volcanic activity on the ocean floor.

name: Marine Geomorphology
description: The study of seafloor landforms and their formation.

name: Marine Paleoclimatology
description: The reconstruction of past climate from marine sediment records.

name: Marine Nitrogen Cycle
description: The transformation and cycling of nitrogen in the ocean.

name: Biological Pump
description: The transport of carbon from the surface to the deep ocean by biological processes.
